Give it everything you got, no retreat!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 15 ([[Huevous Hunt]], Hard)}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Korblox Deathwalker''' was the final boss of [[Huevous Hunt]], where it appeared as part of [[The Hunt Event]]. It had a high amount of health though it walked quite slowly. Additionally, as it was a boss enemy, it could only be slowed down by stunning towers instead of stunned, could not be frozen by freezing towers and could not be slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]]. ==Appearance== The '''Korblox Deathwalker''' was a large ghostly figure which only had skeleton arms and parts of legs. Its torso was replaced by a giant flame and it had no head, only blue flaming eyes. It wore a brown hood with a cape that had four black wings attached to it. On its arms it had blue shoulder-pads and armbands with grey accents. It also had a brown belt with blue crystals and a brown cloth attached to the back of it. It wielded a large brown and grey scythe. ==Strategy== *As the '''Korblox Deathwalker''' has a quite high health for its early appearance. high DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Golden Minigunner]] or [[Accelerator]] are recommended. **The [[Commander]] can greatly help with defeating the '''Korblox Deathwalker''' by boosting the firerate of your towers in hard mode. **The [[DJ Booth]] can also be helpful at increasing the range of towers, allowing them to cover more of the map. *The [[Medic]] can be useful at cleansing the stuns from the '''Korblox Deathwalker'''. **It is also possible to place down Level 0 towers on the side as a distraction, such as the [[Soldier]] or [[Pyromancer]], so that the '''Korblox Deathwalker''' targets unused towers instead of your DPS towers. *As the '''Korblox Deathwalker''' is a boss enemy, it cannot be slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]]. **It also cannot be frozen by freezing towers, but it can still be slowed down by them. **Stunning towers like the [[Warden]] and [[Trapper]] cannot stun the '''Korblox Deathwalker''' but they can still slow it down. **The [[Jester]]'s confusion is unaffected by all of its immunities, making it quite useful against the '''Korblox Deathwalker'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} KorbloxDeathwalkerFloat.gif|Walking animation (15 March 2024 – 30 March 2024) KorbloxDeathwalkerSwing.gif|''Swing'' animation (15 March 2024 – 30 March 2024) KorbloxDeathwalkerDeath.gif|Death animation (15 March 2024 – 30 March 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} TheHuntThumbnail.png|'''Korblox Deathwalker''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} TheHuntIcon.png|'''Korblox Deathwalker''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} The Hunt Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Korblox Deathwalker''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} TheHuntThumbnailClean.png|'''Korblox Deathwalker''' on a render. {{GalleryHeader|Badges}} THBadge1.png|'''Korblox Deathwalker''' on the ''Defeat Deathwalker! | The Hunt First Edition'' [[Badges|badge]]. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Korblox Deathwalker''' was the first enemy with an ability to choreograph the range of the ability itself. *The '''Korblox Deathwalker''' model was taken from a bundle {{RLinkBU|319226|of the same name}}. *On the boss health bar icon, the '''Korblox Deathwalker's''' eyes did not appear. *The '''Korblox Deathwalker''' is the second enemy that used an entirely Roblox made package, with the first being [[Fey Yoshida]]. ==Update History== *'''15 March 2024''' -
